purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Betul

queries.query: Betul Madhya Pradesh official cadastral parcel map land records GIS Bhunaksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Betul district Land Records page, its MP Bhulekh link, and the Government of India DILRMP Betul cadastral digitization status page. The official national Bhunaksha page states that the public-facing system is intended for authorized state officials; no anonymous Betul parcel response was obtained.

queries.query: बैतूल मध्य प्रदेश आधिकारिक भू नक्शा भूमि अभिलेख नक्शा
queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery identified the official Betul district land-records service and MP Bhulekh context, including the public description of searching land records and certified khasra, khatauni, and map copies. No safe Betul parcel geometry or native parcel identity was returned.

registryEvidence.custodian: Betul District Administration, Madhya Pradesh; Commissioner Land Records / Department of Revenue, Government of Madhya Pradesh

registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official Betul district service page links residents to MP Bhulekh for land records, while DILRMP reports cadastral-map digitization status for Betul district. This establishes a local/state registry pathway, not municipal-boundary completeness or public availability of every urban parcel.

parcelDiscovery.source: Government of Madhya Pradesh MP Bhulekh / Betul District Administration; DILRMP status reporting

boundedResponse.viewerRequestOutcome: The official Betul district Land Records page was retrieved successfully and its HTML confirmed the MP Bhulekh link. An ordinary HTTPS GET to MP Bhulekh timed out after 15 seconds before HTML, JavaScript, configuration, or API response could be inspected. A separate ordinary HTTPS GET to the DILRMP Betul status URL failed local TLS certificate verification; no certificate exception was authorized. No exact-point or shifted-coordinate parcel query was attempted.

fieldMapping.safeGeometry: parcel geometry only if returned by the public map route

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted. Timeout and TLS-validation failure are service outcomes, not evidence of citywide absence. No parcel polygon, native parcel identity, CRS, or schema response was retained.

officialSources.observation: Official Betul district administration Land Records page directs users to the MP Bhulekh land-record site and identifies all tehsil offices as the local service location.
Official Madhya Pradesh land-record service URL linked from the Betul district page; direct anonymous GET timed out during this attempt.

Government of India DILRMP page is specifically scoped to MADHYA PRADESH, district BETUL, and reports cadastral-map digitization/geo-referencing status fields; direct fetch was blocked by local certificate validation in this environment.
Official national Bhunaksha page describes cadastral parcel-map management but presents a login for authorized state/UT officials; it was not treated as a public Betul parcel endpoint.
